name: abuse.ch platforms (MalwareBazaar, URLhaus, ThreatFox, YARAify, Feodo Tracker, SSLBL)
operator: abuse.ch (Institute for Cybersecurity and Engineering, Bern University of Applied Sciences) with Spamhaus
tier_rationale: Established security non-profit with published terms (A8 BR2 names abuse.ch as trusted).

reliability.justification: Curated community submissions reviewed by abuse.ch; all six platforms form ONE upstream family for consensus counting (P171 cond 2).

abusech.plan_hint: the Auth-Key is free; it does not license MalwareBazaar/URLhaus/ThreatFox for business use (A1)

malwarebazaar.title: MalwareBazaar (malware sample metadata by hash)

terms.quote: Use of the Platforms listed below by companies, networks, or individuals with commercial or for- profit needs may require a paid subscription, which will be managed by Spamhaus, and will be subject to separate terms and conditions.

malwarebazaar.notes: A1 initial class 'license': the quote is abuse.ch terms 2026-10-21 s.4.1 (verbatim), which lists MalwareBazaar, URLhaus and ThreatFox; s.3.1 limits free authenticated access to 'not-for-profit purposes'. Licence-blocked until a Spamhaus/abuse.ch subscription or written decision is recorded (off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared).
malwarebazaar.licensed_alternative: A Spamhaus/abuse.ch commercial subscription, or a written abuse.ch decision recorded as a licence_allow entry (source id, scope, review date).
